title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
text: We introduce RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework that combines pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation. RAG models retrieve relevant documents and use them as additional context when generating text, achieving state-of-the-art results on open-domain QA, fact verification, and knowledge-intensive generation tasks.
text_summary: RAG combines retrieval with generation for knowledge-intensive NLP, improving QA and fact verification.
